title: Every Batch Is Its Own Validation Set: Leave-One-Out Gradient Matching for Online Data Selection in LLM Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2610.00436v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Online batch selection fine-tunes a language model on the most useful part of each candidate batch. Selectors that match the gradient of the candidate batch are attractive because they need no held-out data, yet they rarely beat training on the whole batch. We show why. In-sample gradient matching uses every example as part of its own target, so its objective credits each example with its own gradient noise. This is the covariance penalty that makes training error optimistic, now sitting on the diagonal of the gradient Gram matrix: it steers selection toward the noisiest examples and makes the full batch the best solution the objective can reach. The fix costs nothing. For each example, the other candidates form an independent sample of the data distribution, so removing the diagonal turns the matching objective into an unbiased estimate of the update's error with respect to the population gradient. translated_title: 每个批次都是它自己的验证集：面向大语言模型微调中在线数据选择的留一梯度匹配
translated_abstract: 在线批次选择在每个候选批次中最有用的部分上对语言模型进行微调。通过匹配候选批次梯度来选择数据的选择器颇具吸引力，因为它们不需要留出数据，但它们很少能胜过在整个批次上的训练。我们展示了其中的原因。样本内梯度匹配将每个样本用作其自身目标的一部分，因此其目标函数将每个样本自身的梯度噪声计入其中。这正是使训练误差显得过于乐观的协方差惩罚，如今它位于梯度Gram矩阵的对角线上：它引导选择偏向噪声最大的样本，并使得整个批次成为该目标所能达到的最佳解决方案。而修复方法无需任何代价。对于每个样本，其他候选样本构成了数据分布的一个独立样本，因此移除对角线后，匹配目标就变成了更新相对于总体梯度误差的无偏估计。这个留一目标的极小化（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文揭示了样本内梯度匹配选择方法失效的根源——梯度Gram矩阵对角线上存在协方差惩罚使其偏向噪声最大的样本——并提出无需任何额外成本的留一梯度匹配方法，通过移除对角线将匹配目标转化为对总体梯度误差的无偏估计。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals why in-sample gradient matching fails in online batch selection—a covariance penalty on the diagonal of the gradient Gram matrix steers selection toward the noisiest examples—and proposes a cost-free leave-one-out gradient matching fix that removes the diagonal, turning the objective into an unbiased estimate of the update's error with respect to the population gradient.
